main_idea: PivotRL training with 50 teacher tasks raises Qwen3.5-9B pass@5 from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: Training uses teacher distillation, hybrid OPD, and PivotRL.
The run profiles 193 pivots from 50 teacher tasks.
General benchmark scores show no significant changes.
summary: The main pass@5 comparison is crowded by branding, a long headline, method details, repeated counts, and secondary benchmark results.
